parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the playbook.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ReleaseVersion
parameters.description:
The release version of the playbook to copy. Default value: 0. Valid values:
- -1: the version currently being edited.

- 0: the latest published version of the playbook.
When SourcePlaybookUuid points to a preset playbook (which you can verify by checking the OwnType field returned by DescribePlaybooks), set ReleaseVersion to 0. Preset playbooks do not have editable draft versions. Setting ReleaseVersion to -1 causes the request to fail.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- **0** (default): the current account view.

- **1**: the global account view.

parameters.name: SourcePlaybookUuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the playbook to copy.
>You can call the [DescribePlaybooks](~~3000306~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
